author_role: AI candidate author, not independent reviewer or native-human certifier

candidates.source: This %1$s contains %2$s frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Broj kadrova u ovoj slici formata %1$s: %2$s. AN Paint uređuje statične slike i ne čuva animaciju."

Preserves format, count, still-image editing and lack of animation preservation. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.semantic_rationale: Estimated combined assembly memory exceeds current limits even at smallest output. Dimension reduction alone is insufficient; both alternatives and unchanged assembly are explicit. No decoder-only or universal-impossibility claim. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Full-image memory and editing reserves, available-memory dependency, stop before oversized allocation and no automatic resize retained. candidates.source: The image credits could not be saved or restored. Existing saved credits have been kept. Try again.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće snimiti ili vratiti. Postojeći snimljeni podaci su sačuvani. Pokušajte ponovo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Attribution/source information, not monetary credits or only author names. Retains save/restore failure, existing stored-data protection and retry. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: These image credits would make the drawing too large to restore. Your previous drawing and credits have been kept.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Zbog ovih podataka o autorima i izvorima slika, količina podataka u crtežu bila bi prevelika za vraćanje. Vaš prethodni crtež i podaci o autorima i izvorima slika su sačuvani."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Excess metadata would prevent drawing restoration; refers to data volume rather than pixel dimensions. Prior drawing and credits retained, not attempted current edit saved. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Some saved credits could not be read. Their stored copies have been kept.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Neke snimljene podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće pročitati. Njihove pohranjene kopije su sačuvane."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Some stored attribution information cannot be read; stored copies remain, without guaranteeing that unreadable copies are usable. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The completed image could not replace its destination.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Odredišnu datoteku nije bilo moguće zamijeniti dovršenom slikom."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Completed image encoding is distinct from failed destination-file replacement; no completed provider-write claim. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The image and encoding buffers exceed the export memory budget.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Slika i baferi za kodiranje premašuju ograničenje memorije za izvoz."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Combined image and encoder buffers exceed export working-memory budget, not disk size or image footprint alone. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Could not open image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Otvaranje slike nije uspjelo"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Image-opening failure prefix without terminal punctuation; the caller appends its error detail. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Could not save image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Snimanje slike nije uspjelo"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Image-save failure prefix without punctuation or an added placeholder; caller supplies separator and details. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvezena datoteka je napravljena. Prije nego što nastavite, koristite „Snimi“ ili „Snimi kao…“ da snimite trenutnu sliku."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Export file was successfully created but did not satisfy save-before-replacement. Exact current Save/Save as commands are still required to save the current image before continuing. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvezite ikonu, Base64 tekst ili ASCII crtež. Izvoz ne mijenja trenutnu sliku niti njeno odredište za naredbu „Snimi“."
candidates.semantic_rationale: All three derived exports retained; neither current image nor Save destination changes. Does not deny creation of a separate output file or claim unsaved changes cleared. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Not enough memory to save in this format. Try PNG
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za snimanje u ovom formatu. Pokušajte s formatom PNG"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Insufficient memory in this format; PNG is a suggestion without a success guarantee. No final period because caller appends error details. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: PNG encoding failed.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "PNG kodiranje nije uspjelo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: PNG encoding failure, not successful output or unsupported decoding. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Save and share…
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Snimi i podijeli…"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Menu action saves a separate copy then launches sharing. Ellipsis matches a following dialog; does not imply changing the current document Save target. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Save and share
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Snimi i podijeli"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Companion dialog title matches the same-family menu label with only the ellipsis removed. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Choose an image format and its compression settings. Save will reuse this file name, location, format and settings.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izaberite format slike i postavke kompresije. Naredba „Snimi“ ponovo će koristiti ovaj naziv datoteke, lokaciju, format i postavke."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Image-format/compression choice; subsequent Save reuses all four items: filename, location, format and settings. Does not equate Save with Export or always-lossy compression. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Saved %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Snimljeno: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Only the named output was written. Suitable for Save, Export and Share without claiming all current document edits are saved; one indexed string token retained. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Save a copy to your chosen location, then choose an app to share it. Your current Save destination stays unchanged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Snimite kopiju na izabranu lokaciju, a zatim izaberite aplikaciju za dijeljenje. Trenutno odredište naredbe „Snimi“ ostaje nepromijenjeno."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Writes a copy before choosing the sharing app; existing Save destination stays unchanged. Does not say sharing already succeeded. formatted=false retained. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The encoder did not finish.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kodiranje nije završeno."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Encoding process did not finish; no ambiguous human coder and no success claim. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The image was saved, but Android could not open sharing: %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Slika je snimljena, ali Android nije mogao pokrenuti dijeljenje: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Successful copy write is separate from failed Android sharing launch; exact appended exception token preserved without a Save-target change claim. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: The selected location is not writable.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na izabranu lokaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Selected location cannot accept writes; cause is not narrowed to permissions or write protection. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: This location is not writable.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na ovu lokaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Generic unwritable location suitable for recovery and source-code exports; no narrower cause or unrelated archive-identity change. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.

candidates.source: Your current image has unsaved changes.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Vaša trenutna slika ima nesnimljene izmjene."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Current working image has unsaved changes; preserves negation/current-document scope instead of referring to a previous draft. Bosnian spelling and syntax; snimanje/Snimi, izbor, rezolucija and historija where relevant.
